form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital typed fillable form; not handwritten. The Office field prints just 'Sheriff' (index.csv says 'County Sheriff' - a naming-convention difference, not a conflict). NEITHER amendment radio button (No / Yes) is marked, so is_amendment is left '' rather than assumed 'No'. Street address block and signature are redacted upstream by the county (black bars) - no residence city survives. This form labels the close box 'G'; the key 'balance_at_close' is kept to match the reference cache shape. Box B is a written '0' (a real zero, not a blank cell). Box C prints '15,228' with no cents.

notes: index.csv variant_guess was legacy_colAB; the filing is in fact the modern Box A-F form (Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor letterhead), with no printed version string in the footer.
